goal: Specify Context Hub information architecture, navigation hierarchy, object grouping, and evidence-reference placement.
non_goals: Do not implement graph engine behavior.
Do not change Phase 5 data ownership.
Do not build signed or release APKs.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
Do not mark native replacement readiness unless this is an explicitly approved Phase 6 readiness task with complete evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Context Hub IA covers overview, memory anchors, notes, source references, diagnostics, and empty/loading/error states.
Evidence-reference placement is explicit enough for a downstream implementation worker to apply without rediscovering IA decisions.
Dependencies on Phase 5 context hub and UX foundation work are recorded.
No prohibited package/signing/PWA release changes are made.
verification_expectations: Validate the IA/spec artifact is internally consistent with Phase 5 task ownership.
Run JSON validation for modified ADworkflo specs.
If UI files are changed by the future worker, run Compose/UI state tests where available and capture screenshots when feasible.
notes: Added as a Phase 5 UI/UX follow-up to split Context Hub IA out of the broad NATIVE-UX-005 surface task.
Use deterministic tests and fakes; real LLM/provider/network/device actions require explicit scope and evidence.
